shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Floating menus, metadata tooltips, and dialogs.

shadows.name: selected-view
shadows.purpose: Small tonal lift for the selected view segment.

motion.name: interface-state
motion.purpose: View background/color, server borders, and button backgrounds.

motion.name: chart-data
motion.purpose: Existing Chart.js canvas data animation; separate from the CSS reduced-motion override.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Filled primary action in the active palette.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid var(--accent, #a55035);border-radius:7px;background:var(--accent, #a55035);color:var(--accent-ink, #ffffff);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #a55035);outline-offset:4px}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border-color, #dfddd4);border-radius:7px;background:var(--bg-card, #fdfcf9);color:var(--text-primary, #302e29);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:var(--bg-hover, #eceae2);border-color:var(--border-active, #b2aca0)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #a55035);outline-offset:4px}.ds-btn-secondary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: Text field
components.description: Labeled administration field with a visible focus treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-server-name">Server name</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-server-name" placeholder="Server name" />
components.css: .ds-field-label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-primary, #302e29)}.ds-field{width:100%;min-height:38px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--input-border, #b2aca0);border-radius:7px;background:var(--input-bg, #fdfcf9);color:var(--text-primary, #302e29);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;font-size:12px;caret-color:var(--accent, #a55035)}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--text-muted, #706b61);opacity:1}.ds-field:focus{border-color:var(--accent, #a55035);outline:2px solid var(--accent-surface, #f2e6dd);box-shadow:none}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-surface, #f2e6dd);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: View selector
components.description: Representative selected and resting view controls.
components.css: .ds-view-group{display:inline-flex;gap:3px;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--border-color, #dfddd4);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg-secondary, #efeee8)}.ds-view{min-height:38px;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary, #625e55);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out}.ds-view-active{background:var(--bg-card, #fdfcf9);color:var(--accent, #a55035);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #302e2914}.ds-view:hover:not(.ds-view-active){background:var(--bg-hover, #eceae2);color:var(--text-primary, #302e29)}.ds-view:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #a55035);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-view{transition:none}}

components.name: Selected region filter
components.description: Selected region control with a count; sample content is illustrative.
components.css: .ds-filter{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:34px;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid var(--accent, #a55035);border-radius:7px;background:var(--accent-surface, #f2e6dd);color:var(--accent, #a55035);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer}.ds-filter-count{color:var(--text-muted, #706b61);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-filter:hover{border-color:var(--border-active, #b2aca0)}.ds-filter:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #a55035);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Server card
components.description: Neutral navigable metric surface; specimen contains no real measurement.
components.css: .ds-server-card{display:block;padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--border-color, #dfddd4);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card, #fdfcf9);color:var(--text-primary, #302e29);text-decoration:none;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;transition:border-color 160ms ease-out,background-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-server-card:hover{border-color:var(--border-active, #b2aca0);box-shadow:none;transform:none}.ds-server-card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #a55035);outline-offset:4px}.ds-server-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-server-state{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-secondary, #625e55)}.ds-server-metrics{display:flex;gap:24px;margin-top:18px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-color, #dfddd4);font-size:11px;color:var(--text-secondary, #625e55)}.ds-server-metrics strong{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:22px;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--text-primary, #302e29)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-server-card{transition:none}}

components.name: Chart container
components.description: Chart header and empty plotting region, without synthetic data.
components.html:
CPU—
No sample data
components.css: .ds-chart{padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--border-color, #dfddd4);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg-card, #fdfcf9);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;color:var(--text-primary, #302e29)}.ds-chart-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color, #dfddd4);font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.ds-chart-value{font-size:17px;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--accent, #a55035)}.ds-chart-empty{padding:44px 0;color:var(--text-muted, #706b61);font-size:12px;text-align:center}

components.name: Administration tabs
components.description: Lightweight navigation with a terracotta selection underline.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Administration"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active" type="button" aria-current="page">Servers</button><button class="ds-tab" type="button">Settings</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color, #dfddd4);overflow-x:auto}.ds-tab{padding:12px 0;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:transparent;color:var(--text-secondary, #625e55);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-tab-active{border-bottom-color:var(--accent, #a55035);color:var(--accent, #a55035)}.ds-tab:hover{color:var(--text-primary, #302e29)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #a55035);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
Claude-inspired warmth gives the existing monitoring interface a calm application character: warm paper in light mode, warm charcoal in dark mode, measured terracotta accents, and serif page headings. This is the project's own interface and identity; the reference does not imply Claude affiliation.

Data remains the visual center. Neutral surfaces and thin dividers organize dense readings, while tabular numerals keep live updates steady. The same palette and type vocabulary extend to server details, login, and administration. English and Chinese, including CJK heading fallbacks, share this system.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces with a restrained terracotta action accent.
Serif orientation headings paired with system sans controls and measurements.
Flat bordered cards, clear operational labels, and stable numeric alignment.
Responsive layouts and equivalent light, dark, and system-following themes.

rules.name: The Operational Meaning Rule
rules.body: Keep action selection separate from monitoring state: terracotta selects and acts; green, ochre, and red retain the existing operational thresholds and labels.

rules.name: The Reading Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use theme tokens for small chart-header text, axes, and status labels. Keep swap percentages at full opacity in supporting ink; reserve faded treatments for decorative tracks or explicitly disabled controls.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use serif type for identity and orientation headings. Keep controls, table rows, resource labels, and numeric readings in sans; reserve monospace for code and commands.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Ordinary cards stay flat, including on hover. Use tonal separation and border changes for interaction; reserve the large shadow for floating menus, tooltips, and dialogs.

dos: Do use the shared theme variables for new interface surfaces and chart series.
Do preserve explicit status wording, units, and existing data thresholds alongside color.
Do allow long server names and translated labels to wrap without pushing the page sideways.
Do use tabular numerals for metrics and keep small supporting measurements fully legible.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and respect the existing reduced-motion CSS.
Do keep the configured site title, attribution, monitoring controls, and real measurements intact.
donts: Don't introduce terminal scanlines, glowing text, or lifting card hover effects into this visual system.
Don't use terracotta as a substitute for healthy, warning, or offline state.
Don't use the serif heading face for dense tables or operational values.
Don't add Claude logos, affiliation claims, invented servers, or illustrative monitoring data.
Don't assume a larger viewport when placing chart timestamps; use the implemented width-aware tick limit.
